name: le-revenu-forum
description: Forum communautaire Le Revenu — Next.js 15 (frontend) + Strapi v5 (backend) + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c red,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c red,blue "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
